notes: Beta 1.1.1.5: startup no longer rescans an unchanged library (a persisted directory fingerprint is checked with a directory-only walk), album covers extracted from local files are now cached on disk so restarts no longer re-run ffmpeg, and cover contention returns a retryable busy instead of a false 404; manually chosen covers now always win. · 测试版 1.1.1.5：库没有变化时启动不再整库重扫（只遍历目录比对持久指纹）；本地内嵌/同目录封面落盘缓存，重启不再重跑 ffmpeg；封面并发争用改为可重试的忙状态而不是假 404；人工封面永久优先。
